name: mirage
text:
Disappearing bets: not fixed yet. The newest report (4:14 PM EDT) is from after the engine restarted with the v1.0.77 fix, and it still shows the list collapsing on your phone. Examples: 15 bets to 6, 10 to 0, 8 to 1, roughly every 1-2 minutes between 3:57 and 4:07 PM. The engine itself is publishing 18 rows right now, so the empty-list-at-scan-start cause I fixed was real but wasn't the only one. My leading suspect is the phone hiding rows whose fair odds look too old (the engine's fair odds run 3-8 minutes old). The other is the phone re-pricing partial Novig books. I'm working through those next.
'No one is selling at that price': I can't tell from this report. It only shows up when a bet is tried, and the logs have no such attempt since 14:26 because scanning was paused. When you try a bet, tell me roughly when and I'll match it to the logs.
